title: Regulation, Markets, and Energy Affordability
content: Rising electricity bills are causing regulators and policymakers to reconsider state-level clean energy and environmental goals. Yet the need to raise capital for investment in power generation and distribution utility infrastructure is increasing as the industry struggles to meet growing electricity demand. As safety and reliability remain the top priorities for electric utilities, regulators are experimenting with novel approaches to regulation that encourage investment in infrastructure and position utilities for financial stability while addressing affordability concerns.
author: Paul A. DeCotis
